thread:
meera: quick thread 1 - we need to finalize the console contract for adaptive SLO thresholds -> routing. two competing ideas: (A) compute proposal per-tenant and let routing use an independently rate-limited "effective_threshold", or (B) have a single service-side decision that atomically computes+applies. pros/cons?

dave: option A gives visibility and manual vetting in the console, option B is simpler for consistency but risks mass-change blasts. my vote is A with a global apply-smoother.

samuel: agreed. also add per-region budget and per-tenant min_samples gate. we saw noisy stddev on low-traffic tenants last quarter. need fallback to org-default.

meera: thinking UI: show "proposed" and "effective" rows. proposed = ewma(p95)+alpha*std, effective = smoother(proposed, global_budget). show why a diff exists (reason codes).

dave: telemetry must include event types: proposal_generated, local_gate(fallback_reason), smoother_decision(reason), applied_threshold_event. dashboards: proposed_vs_effective_ts, global_budget_util, per-tenant_fallback_rate.

samuel: policy knobs i sketched:

```yaml
autotune:
  metric: p95_latency_ms
  baseline: ewma(24h)
  alpha: 1.4
  min_samples: 100
  max_delta_ms: 300
  hysteresis_windows: 3
  smoother:
    budget_tokens_per_hour: 10000
    recovery_half_life_minutes: 180
    min_apply_cost: 10
    global_rate_limit_per_min: 20
  notify_backpressure:
    queue_depth_warn: 500
    pause_on_error_rate_pct: 1.0
  ui:
    show_confidence: true
    require_audit_reason_on_apply: true
```

small comment: apply_cost should be est_fanout * delta_pct, not linear per-tenant.

meera: yep will include est_fanout. also want a "routing_influence" flag (0..1) per-org so customers can pick conservative vs aggressive. default 0.5.

dave: rollout plan: 1) historical sim against last 90d traces, 2) shadow compute (72h) for small cohort -> produce proposed_ts and estimate fanout, 3) staged canary with routing_influence=0.8 for 24h, 4) widen if notify_delta < 5% and regression_rate below baseline. ops kill-switch always available.

samuel: add safety: global_apply_rate limiter + a short randomized stagger when applying effective thresholds so we don't align many tenants at once. and if fallback fraction > 10% pause and notify product.

ops-bot: scheduled shadow run autotune-shadow-2026-05 start=2887659000 duration=72h. monitoring dashboards: https://console.internal/dashboards/autotune-shadow-2887659000

meera: API contract notes: POST /orgs/{org}/autotune/proposals -> returns {proposed, confidence, sample_count, est_fanout}
PATCH /orgs/{org}/autotune/apply -> {mode: shadow|staged|live, routing_influence, audit_reason}
we should require audit_reason when mode=live.

dave: make sure we emit audit_event with actor, reason, prev_threshold, new_threshold. store in per-org audit index and link from console.

samuel: unit/integration tests: constant series, tiny-sample, spike-injection, smoother token-bucket exhaustion, backpressure pause. also an e2e test that asserts notify_fanout delta <= configured threshold for canary.

meera: ill draft the RFC with knobs, API, UI mocks, telemetry panels and rollout steps. planning sim this week. tagging @dave @samuel for review. :thumbsup:

dave: +1

samuel: +1, will review RFC tonight.
